arms.description: Participants randomized to the ketogenic diet will follow a diet with 5% energy from carbohydrates, 70% from fat, and 25% from protein for 6 weeks. The first 2 of the 6 weeks weeks will be a gradual refeeding, with participants slowly withdrawing from the meal replacements used during the 4-week weight loss phase, while introducing more food.
arms.label: Ketogenic Diet

arms.description: Participants randomized to the low-fat diet will follow a diet with 50% energy from carbohydrates, 25% energy from fat, and 25% energy from protein for 6 weeks. The first 2 of the 6 weeks weeks will be a gradual refeeding, with participants slowly withdrawing from the meal replacements used during the 4-week weight loss phase, while introducing more food.
arms.label: Low-Fat Diet

eligibility.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI 30-45 kg/m2
* Both men and women
* Age between 18-65 years
* Sedentary to moderately active (\<2 h/wk of moderate, structured, intentional, exercise)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy or lactation
* Daily use of tobacco (\>1 pk/wk)
* Change in weight greater than 5 lb in the previous 3 months
* Cognitive impairment
* Previous bariatric surgery
* History of eating disorder
* Presence of any condition (e.g. DM2, PCOS, inflammatory disease, untreated thyroid disease, fluid overload states such as chronic kidney disease, congestive heart failure, or cirrhosis)
* Use of any medication (e.g., glucocorticoid, GLP-1 analogues, hormone replacement therapy) deemed to interfere with study outcomes.
* Pre-menopausal women will need to have a regular menstrual cycle (28+/-2 days) or be on hormonal contraceptives
* Fasting glucose plasma concentration \>125 mg/dl and/or HbA1c \> 6.4%

interventions.description: Participants will be provided food to meet the ketogenic diet prescription for the 6-week weight maintenance phase.
interventions.name: Diet Therapy

interventions.description: Participants will follow a commercial low-energy diet and be provided with meal replacements for 4 weeks aiming to achieve a minimum of 5% weight loss.
interventions.name: Calorie Restriction

interventions.description: Participants will meet weekly with a registered dietitian, for a 20-minute consultation throughout the entire study period (10 weeks) to increase engagement and improve adherence and retention.
interventions.name: Behavioral Support

interventions.description: Participants will have food provided to meet the standard low-fat diet prescription for the 6-week weight maintenance phase.
interventions.name: Diet Therapy

outcomes.description: Total Energy Expenditure (TEE) refers to the total amount of energy (calories) your body uses in a day. Twenty-four-hour EE and RQ will be measured inside the whole room indirect calorimeter (chamber) following standard procedures
outcomes.measure: Change from baseline total energy expenditure

outcomes.description: Subjective appetite ratings are personal feelings or perceptions about hunger, fullness, desire to eat (DTE), and prospective food consumption (PFC) usually measured using self-reported scales ranging from "not at all" to "extremely". Subjective appetite ratings (hunger, fullness, DTE and PFC) will be measured using a validated 10cm visual analog scale which will be given to the participants inside the chamber before meals.
Bioimpedance analysis (BIA) will be used to measure fat mass, fat-free mass, total, extra, and intra-cellular water.
FM, bone mass, and lean body mass will be determined by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (iDXA instrument, GE Healthcare Lunar, Madison, WI) with the use of software version 1.5g (Lunar Corp).
Circulating (serum) fasting insulin will be measured using validated methods
Circulating (plasma) fasting cholecystokinin will be measured by RIA.
Circulating (plasma) fasting ghrelin concentrations will be measured by ELISA
Circulating (plasma) fasting total GLP-1 will be measured by ELISA
Circulating (plasma) fasting PYY3-36 concentrations will be measured by ELISA
Body weight is the total amount a person weighs when measured on a scale.

Walking economy will be assessed using a submaximal treadmill test, performed 90 minutes after breakfast. Following a familiarization period, participant will walk on the treadmill at 2 miles/hour for 15 minutes, followed by another 15 minutes at 2.5 miles/hour.

Resting Energy Expenditure (REE) is the amount of energy (calories) your body needs to keep working while you're at rest. Participants will enter the chamber in the morning in the fasting state. REE will be measured while the participant is in the metabolic chamber.
Circulating (serum) insulin measured before and 30, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after intake of breakfast with validated methods
Circulating (plasma) cholecystokinin measured before and 30, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after intake of breakfast with RIA.
Circulating (plasma) ghrelin measured before and 30, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after intake of breakfast with ELISA
Circulating (plasma) total GLP-1 measured before and 30, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after intake of breakfast by ELISA
Circulating (plasma) PYY3-36 concentrations measured before and 30, 60, 90, and 120 minutes after intake of breakfast with ELISA
Adherence to the dietary interventions will be assessed using objective biochemical analysis through the measurement of beta hydroxybutyrate in blood using a ketone meter.
outcomes.time_frame: Week 1, week 2, week 3, week 4, week 5, week 6, week 7, week 8, week 9, week 10

outcomes.description: Adherence to the dietary interventions will be assessed using objective biochemical analysis through the measurement of acetoacetate in urine using Ketostix reagent strips.
outcomes.time_frame: Week 1, week 2, week 3, week 4, week 5, week 6, week 7, week 8, week 9, week 10

outcomes.description: The fasting blood sample collected before the participants enter the chamber will be analyzed for circulating glucose using the SIRRUS analyzer.
The fasting blood sample collected before the participants enter the chamber will be analyzed for circulating total cholesterol concentrations using the SIRRUS analyzer.
The fasting blood sample collected before the participants enter the chamber will be analyzed for circulating HDL-C using the SIRRUS analyzer.
The fasting blood sample collected before the participants enter the chamber will be analyzed for circulating triglyceride concentrations using the SIRRUS analyzer.
The fasting blood sample collected before the participants enter the chamber will be analyzed for circulating free fatty acid concentrations using the SIRRUS analyzer.

Participants will be asked to report their average hunger, fullness, desire to eat and prospective food consumption (e.g. how hungry did you feel this week? how much did you think about food this week?) over the previous week using a 10-cm visual analogue scale ranging from "not at all" to "extremely".

trial.brief_summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to investigate whether a Ketogenic Diet (KD) can increase Total Energy Expenditure (TEE), while benefiting appetite, during weight loss maintenance in reduced-obese individuals.
trial.brief_title: Ketogenic Diets for Weight Loss Maintenance: Impact on Energy Expenditure and Appetite in Individuals With Obesity
collaborator_names: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)
trial.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI 30-45 kg/m2
* Both men and women
* Age between 18-65 years
* Sedentary to moderately active (\<2 h/wk of moderate, structured, intentional, exercise)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy or lactation
* Daily use of tobacco (\>1 pk/wk)
* Change in weight greater than 5 lb in the previous 3 months
* Cognitive impairment
* Previous bariatric surgery
* History of eating disorder
* Presence of any condition (e.g. DM2, PCOS, inflammatory disease, untreated thyroid disease, fluid overload states such as chronic kidney disease, congestive heart failure, or cirrhosis)
* Use of any medication (e.g., glucocorticoid, GLP-1 analogues, hormone replacement therapy) deemed to interfere with study outcomes.
* Pre-menopausal women will need to have a regular menstrual cycle (28+/-2 days) or be on hormonal contraceptives
* Fasting glucose plasma concentration \>125 mg/dl and/or HbA1c \> 6.4%
trial.detailed_description: The total duration of the intervention will be 10 weeks. Participants will first undergo 4 weeks of a low-energy diet (LED), aiming to induce a minimum of 5% weight loss (weight loss phase). Those who achieve at least a 5% weight loss will then be randomized (1:1) to a 6-week weight loss maintenance (WLM) diet, either a KD or an isocaloric low-fat diet, with the first 2 weeks being a gradual refeeding.
trial.official_title: Ketogenic Diets for Weight Loss Maintenance: Impact on Energy Expenditure and Appetite in Individuals With Obesity
